scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
Are you going into the forest?
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
你要進森林嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
Well, well, well, aren't you being too rash?
Why don't you at least organize a party?
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
哎呀，哎呀，哎呀，你太魯莽了吧？
至少組建一個隊伍再進去吧？

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
...Are you sure you're not doing too much?
I think you'd better get some rest.
You'll only wear yourself out by trying to do too much
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
...你確定自己不會太勉強嗎？
我覺得你最好休息一下。
做太多事情只會讓你精疲力竭。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
I don't think the authority will give you permission, either.
...Even a Sapha would be stopped from entering the forest.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
我覺得當局也不會給你許可的。
...即使是薩法，也會被阻止進入森林。

scripts.text: You speak our language quite well, don't you?
scripts.translation: 你的語言說得很好啊，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
...Do I?
Actually I'm not speaking your language.
I'm speaking Laphine language.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
...是嗎？
其實我說的不是你們的語言。
我說的是拉菲尼語。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
But it's one of the mysteries of Bifrost.
That we can understand each other even if we speak different languages.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
但這是雙層牛肉堡的一個奧秘。
即使我們說著不同的語言，也能互相理解。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
To be able to talk with everybody...
Perhaps that's the power of Bifrost.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
能夠與所有人交談...
也許這就是雙層牛肉堡的力量。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
Great, great.
Now the forest won't reject you.
What are you going to do now?
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
很好，很好。
現在森林不會排斥你了。
你接下來打算做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
You human adventurers are incredible.
You're always going into the forest, where no one else dares to go.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
你們人類冒險者真是不可思議。
總是去那些沒人敢去的森林。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
Phew. But I have to report to the authority
everyone who goes into the forest, just in case.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
呼。但我必須向當局報告每一個進入森林的人，以防萬一。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
You'll get permission
after you register.
Are you going to venture into the Hazy Forest?
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
登記後你就會獲得許可。
你要去迷霧森林嗎？

scripts.text: Venture into the Hazy Forest.
scripts.translation: 前往迷霧森林

scripts.text: Give up.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
Party Name {0}...
Party Leader {1}...
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
隊伍名稱 {0}...
隊伍首領 {1}...
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
Party Name {0}...
Party Leader {1}...
I've got it. I've written them down on the report here.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
隊伍名稱 {0}...
隊伍首領 {1}...
我記下了。我已經把它們寫在報告上了。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
It's dangerous in the forest.
...Why don't you just go back today?
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
森林裡很危險。
...今天還是回去吧？

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
The atmosphere is somewhat tense in the forest.
...Why don't you just go back today?
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
森林裡的氣氛有些緊張。
...今天還是回去吧？

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
You'll get permission soon.
Now go to the log tunnel, the only way to get into the Hazy Forest.
You understand?
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
你很快就會獲得許可。
現在去原木隧道，那是進入迷霧森林的唯一途徑。
明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
We can't go against the forest,
but maybe you humans can.
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
我們不能違背森林，
但也許你們人類可以。
祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
Well, you've made the right decision.
That's what's good for you.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
嗯，你做了正確的決定。
這對你是好事。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
Well, you've made the right decision.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
嗯，你做了正確的決定。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
Where's your party leader?
It's dangerous in there.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
你的隊伍首領在哪裡？
裡面很危險。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
I see you've been into the forest before.
Okay, at least the forest won't reject you.
However...
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
看來你以前進過森林。
好吧，至少森林不會排斥你。
但是...

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
Put yourself in my shoes, the entrance guard, and let me meet the representative of your party.
I have to discuss some things with him/her.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
請站在我的立場上想想，作為入口守衛，我必須見一見你們隊伍的代表。
我有事要和他/她商量。

scripts.text:
I see the forest through the log tunnel.
It looks like I can enter the forest through the log tunnel.
scripts.translation:
透過原木隧道，我能看到森林。
看起來可以通過原木隧道進入森林。

scripts.text: Enter the tunnel.
scripts.translation: 進入隧道

scripts.text: Give up.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
Something doesn't feel right. Looks like something dangerous is going on, so you'd better turn back today.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
感覺有些不對勁。
看起來有什麼危險正在發生，你最好今天先回去。

scripts.text:
You try to crawl into the log, but some mysterious power pushes you back with a gush of wind.
It seems like you can't force your way into the forest.
scripts.translation:
你試圖爬進原木，但一股神秘的力量伴隨著狂風將你推了回去。
看來無法強行進入森林。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
Hey, look!
Are you going alone?
That's impossible. Too rash.
Team up with some friends and go together!
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
嘿，看！
你是要一個人去嗎？
那是不可能的。太魯莽了。
找些朋友組隊一起去吧！

scripts.text:
The world beyond the log tunnel looks dark and suffocating.
Your instinct is screaming that this forest is dangerous.
scripts.translation:
原木隧道另一邊的世界看起來黑暗而令人窒息。
你的直覺在尖叫，這片森林很危險。

scripts.text:
Obviously no one is taking care of it.
It seems like you can chop down the garden tree.
scripts.translation:
顯然沒人照顧它。
看起來可以砍倒這棵花園裡的樹。

scripts.text: Chop down the garden tree.
scripts.translation: 砍倒花園裡的樹

scripts.text: Give up.
scripts.translation: 算了

placeholders: ((getarg(3,0))?"clearing the way out of the forest.":"so now you can continue.")
scripts.text: You chop down the tree, which was blocking the path of the maze, {0}
scripts.translation: 你砍倒了那棵擋在迷宮路徑上的樹，{0}

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Young Man]
Huh? Do you plan to pass through here?
.....I'm afraid it's beyond your ability, but I won't meddle in your affairs.
We'll meet again, if you survive.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的年輕人]
嗯？你打算從這裡通過嗎？
...恐怕這超出了你的能力範圍，但我不干涉你的事。
如果你能活下來，我們還會再見的。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Young Man]
You... I remember seeing you at the camp.
The information you gave on Ahat was useful.
Thanks!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的年輕人]
你...我記得在營地見過你。
你提供的關於阿哈特的資訊很有用。
謝謝！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Young Man]
But do you plan to pass through here?
What good is it to go across Bifrost?
scripts.translation:
[神秘的年輕人]
但你打算從這裡通過嗎？
穿過雙層牛肉堡有什麼好處？

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Young Man]
Do you plan to pass through here?
I will advise against it if you're just curious.
It will only bring about your untimely death...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的年輕人]
你打算從這裡通過嗎？
如果你只是好奇，我勸你打消這個念頭。
那隻會帶來你的非正常死亡...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Young Man]
If you are determined to pass through here,
I will ask for your help with something.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的年輕人]
如果你決心要從這裡通過，
我想請你幫個忙。

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Loki]
Loki... from the Assassin's Guild.
That's my name.
And yours?
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
洛基...來自刺客公會。
這是我的名字。
還有你的名字？

scripts.text:
[Loki]
I see. {0}.
I'm asking you again.
Do you plan to pass through this forest?
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
原來如此，{0}。
我再問你一次。
你打算穿過這片森林嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 有的，我有。

scripts.text: No, I don't.
scripts.translation: 沒有，我沒有。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
Then I'll ask you a question.
Have you ever seen a guard... a girl with purple hair?
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
那麼我問你個問題。
你見過一個衛兵嗎...一個紫發的女孩？

scripts.text: No, I haven't.
scripts.translation: 不，沒見過。

scripts.text: Yes, I might have...
scripts.translation: 是的，我好像見過...

scripts.text:
[Loki]
So you haven't.
You're telling the truth.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
看來你沒見過。
你在說實話。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
Wait.
(Loki comes closer.)
... No.
You're telling the truth.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
等等。
(洛基走近了一些。)
...不。
你在說實話。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
Now we have to say goodbye here.
If you survive this forest, of course.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
我們在這裡分別吧。
當然，前提是你得活著穿過這片森林。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
I understand.
Step back if you aren't ready.
This forest doesn't like strangers.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
我明白了。
如果你還沒準備好，就退後吧。
這片森林不喜歡陌生人。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
I told you - step back if you don't want to die.
It's not easy going through the forest.
It may cost you your life.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
我告訴過你——如果你不想死，就退後。
穿過這片森林並不容易。
它可能會奪走你的生命。

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text: What do you want?
scripts.translation: 你想要什麼？

scripts.text:
- When you step back,
Loki nods slightly and then looks away. -
scripts.translation:
- 當你退後時，
洛基微微點頭，然後移開了視線。 -

scripts.text:
[Loki]
I'm looking for somebody.
Have you ever seen a guard... a girl with purple hair?
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
我在找一個人。
你見過一個衛兵嗎...一個紫發的女孩？

scripts.text: No, I haven't.
scripts.translation: 不，沒見過。

scripts.text: Yes, I might have...
scripts.translation: 是的，我好像見過...

scripts.text:
[Loki]
So you haven't.
You're telling the truth.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
看來你沒見過。
你在說實話。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
Wait.
(Loki comes closer.)
... No.
You're telling the truth.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
等等。
(洛基走近了一些。)
...不。
你在說實話。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
Now we have to say goodbye here.
Hopefully, we will see each other again in Mora.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
我們在這裡分別吧。
希望下次能在穆拉再見到你。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
I don't want to go with you.
Hopefully, we will see each other again in Mora.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
我不想和你一起走。
希望下次能在穆拉再見到你。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
So we meet again.
Are you used to this place?
Come to the inn in Mora.
I have something to give to you.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
我們又見面了。
你習慣這裡了嗎？
來穆拉的旅館吧。
我有東西要給你。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
We're seeing a lot of each other these days.
It seems you are completely comfortable with the place.
You'd better not be too proud of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
最近我們見面的次數真多。
看來你完全適應這裡了。
你最好別太得意忘形。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
An adventurer in the forest.
.....
You can go to Mora through this forest.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
森林裡的冒險者。
.....
你可以穿過這片森林去穆拉。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
Is it you that took care of this unruly girl?
I guess I have to thank you.
You've calmed her down.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
是你照顧了這個不聽話的女孩嗎？
看來我得謝謝你。
你讓她平靜下來了。

scripts.text: What's happening?
scripts.translation: 發生什麼事了？

scripts.text: This girl...?
scripts.translation: 這個女孩...？

scripts.text:
[Loki]
You might be able to change your appearance, but you cannot change your unique, innate light.
A scent strong enough to burn your nose.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
你可以改變自己的外表，
但無法改變你與生俱來的獨特光芒。
那是一種強烈到灼燒鼻息的氣味。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
This is Nydhogg, the Guardian of Yggdrasil,
whom I was looking for.
Now she won't wander around crazy any more.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
這就是尼德霍格，世界樹的守護者，
正是我在尋找的人。
現在她不會再瘋瘋癲癲地四處遊蕩了。

scripts.text: What are you going to do now?
scripts.translation: 你接下來打算做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Loki]
I'll wait for her to wake up and get out of this forest.
I can manage it on my own.
I'll see you in Mora.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
我會等她醒來，然後離開這片森林。
我一個人能搞定。
我們在穆拉見。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
I don't want to go with you.
I can manage her on my own.
If you have something to say, say it after we get out of the forest.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
我不想和你一起走。
我一個人能照顧好她。
如果你有什麼話想說，等我們離開森林後再說。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
I don't want to go with you.
If you have something to say, say it after we get out of the forest.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
我不想和你一起走。
如果你有什麼話想說，等我們離開森林後再說。

scripts.text:
You see a girl with mysterious hair collapsed on the ground.
As you approach her, you smell the scent of flowers so strong that it makes you dizzy.
scripts.translation:
你看到一個有著神秘髮色的女孩倒在地上。
當你走近她時，聞到了一股濃郁的花香，讓你有些頭暈。

scripts.text:
[Flower Smell Lady]
I need rest.
I'm too tired to talk to you.
I'm sorry.
scripts.translation:
[聞花香的女士]
我需要休息。
我太累了，沒法和你說話。
抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Nydhogg the Guardian]
I've been waiting for you.
I'm still confused, but I know what I did wrong.
scripts.translation:
[守護者 尼德霍格]
我一直在等你。
我仍然有些困惑，但我知道自己錯在哪裡了。

scripts.text:
[Nydhogg the Guardian]
If it weren't for you, I would still be wandering in the abyssal darkness.
I thank you, from the bottom of my heart.
scripts.translation:
[守護者 尼德霍格]
如果沒有你，我可能還在無底的黑暗中徘徊。
我從心底感謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Nydhogg the Guardian]
I'm ashamed of myself, falling for the sweet but empty words that came to me in my loneliness.
....
scripts.translation:
[守護者 尼德霍格]
我很羞愧，在孤獨中竟然被那些甜美卻空洞的話語所迷惑。
....

scripts.text:
[Nydhogg the Guardian]
I don't deserve to be a guardian any more.
A dragon gone crazy is not a guardian any more.
scripts.translation:
[守護者 尼德霍格]
我不再配做守護者了。
一條瘋了的龍，不再是守護者。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
Yggdrasil doesn't think so.
Nidi, don't forget your duties.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
世界樹並不這麼認為。
尼德，別忘了你的職責。

scripts.text:
[Nydhogg the Guardian]
Are you...?
I see...
I thought I was forsaken...
scripts.translation:
[守護者 尼德霍格]
是你...？
我明白了...
我以為自己被拋棄了...

scripts.text: The Guardian slowly looked away as if deep in thought.
scripts.translation: 守護者緩緩移開目光，似乎陷入了沉思。

scripts.text: - He seems to be deep in thought. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎陷入了沉思。 -

scripts.text:
[Nydhogg the Guardian]
I haven't gotten all of my powers back.
I'm sorry I can't protect you.
scripts.translation:
[守護者 尼德霍格]
我還沒有完全恢復力量。
抱歉，我無法保護你。

scripts.text:
[Nydhogg the Guardian]
Loki said...
that I won't cry from loneliness again,
that I will always have new friends like you...
scripts.translation:
[守護者 尼德霍格]
洛基說...
我不會再因孤獨而哭泣，
我會一直擁有像你這樣的新朋友...

scripts.text:
[Nydhogg the Guardian]
...I've lost everything, but I'm happy now.
scripts.translation:
[守護者 尼德霍格]
...我失去了一切，但現在我很幸福。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to do this quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品欄太滿了，無法執行此任務。 -

scripts.text: He won't look at you. It's like he's not interested at all.
scripts.translation: 他不願看你一眼。看起來他對你毫無興趣。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
So you've passed through the forest.
It seems Niddy has something to say to you.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
看來你已經穿過了森林。
尼德霍格似乎有話想對你說。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
Nydhogg was one of the guardians of the World Tree.
But he abandoned his duties as a guardian when he gave in to Morocc's temptation.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
尼德霍格曾是世界樹的守護者之一。
但他屈服於摩洛克的誘惑，拋棄了守護者的職責。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
Some fools performed a ritual to break the seal that held Morocc.
But the ritual didn't work right. The servant of Morocc failed to break the seal.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
一些愚者試圖舉行儀式，打破封印摩洛克的結界。
但儀式失敗了。摩洛克的僕從沒能打破封印。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
But the seal is so weak that it can break open any time.
It's Yggdrasil the World Tree's will that has kept the seal from breaking.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
但封印已經非常脆弱，隨時可能破碎。
正是世界樹尤克特拉希爾的意志，維持著封印不被打破。

scripts.text:
[Nydhogg the Guardian]
That's right. The power of the World Tree is linked to the whole world.
When the bond between the guardians and Yggdrasil broke, Yggdrasil became unstable.
scripts.translation:
[守護者 尼德霍格]
沒錯。世界樹的力量與世界相連。
當守護者與世界樹的聯絡斷裂時，世界樹變得不穩定了。

scripts.text:
[Nydhogg the Guardian]
That's why all those disasters happened to Yggdrasil.
As the World Tree became unstable, the influence it had on the seal grew weak.
scripts.translation:
[守護者 尼德霍格]
這就是為什麼世界樹發生了那麼多災難。
隨著世界樹變得不穩定，它對封印的影響也減弱了。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
And Morocc broke himself free from the seal.
Although it seems like he used most of his powers just to break the seal...
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
於是摩洛克掙脫了封印。
雖然看起來他為了打破封印消耗了大部分力量...

scripts.text:
[Nydhogg the Guardian]
It's all my fault.
I couldn't break free from Morocc's temptation.
For too... too long...
scripts.translation:
[守護者 尼德霍格]
這都是我的錯。
我無法擺脫摩洛克的誘惑。
太...太久了...

scripts.text:
[Nydhogg the Guardian]
...I wanted to be relieved of my thousands of years of loneliness.
I wasn't in my right mind then.
It was none other than I that broke my bond with Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[守護者 尼德霍格]
...我想擺脫數千年的孤獨。
那時我已神志不清。
是我自己切斷了與世界樹的聯絡。

scripts.text:
[Nydhogg the Guardian]
I lost control of myself, and did what I shouldn't have done.
The other side of me became a shadow and a reckless tyrant.
scripts.translation:
[守護者 尼德霍格]
我失去了理智，做了不該做的事。
我的另一面變成了陰影和瘋狂的暴君。

scripts.text:
[Nydhogg the Guardian]
Facing the world, I realized...
I felt too great a sense of loss... it was much more painful than the loneliness I had endured for thousands of years.
scripts.translation:
[守護者 尼德霍格]
面對世界時，我意識到...
我感到巨大的失落...這比忍受數千年的孤獨更痛苦。

scripts.text:
[Nydhogg the Guardian]
That's how I was left alone.
I felt too great a sense of loss... it was much more painful than the loneliness I had endured for thousands of years.
scripts.translation:
[守護者 尼德霍格]
就這樣，我被獨自留下了。
我感到巨大的失落...這比忍受數千年的孤獨更痛苦。

scripts.text:
[Nydhogg the Guardian]
So I became a sinner, forgotten to the world.
scripts.translation:
[守護者 尼德霍格]
所以我成為了一個被世界遺忘的罪人。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
It's not too late.
You're still a guardian.
You still have things to do.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
還不晚。
你仍然是守護者。
你仍有職責要履行。

scripts.text:
[Nydhogg the Guardian]
...Oh, yes. It's late, but I have to fulfill my duties as a guardian.
Now I know. I'll destroy Morocc with my own hands.
I will fulfill my duties as a guardian.
scripts.translation:
[守護者 尼德霍格]
...噢，是的。雖然晚了，但我必須履行守護者的職責。
我現在明白了。我會親手消滅摩洛克。
我將履行守護者的職責。

scripts.text: You're not alone.
scripts.translation: 你並不孤單。

scripts.text: Those are very important duties.
scripts.translation: 那是非常重要的職責。

scripts.text:
[Nydhogg the Guardian]
You're right.
It may be why I haven't been forsaken - to realize that I'm not alone.
You are a kind soul.
scripts.translation:
[守護者 尼德霍格]
你說得對。
也許這就是我沒有被拋棄的原因——意識到我並不孤單。
你有一顆善良的心。

scripts.text:
[Nydhogg the Guardian]
But this is my atonement.
I'm happy, though.
I don't have to fight the loneliness any more.
scripts.translation:
[守護者 尼德霍格]
但這是我的贖罪。
不過，我很幸福。
我不必再與孤獨鬥爭了。

scripts.text:
[Nydhogg the Guardian]
{0}...
Thanks for listening to my long story.
scripts.translation:
[守護者 尼德霍格]
{0}...
謝謝你聽我講這些漫長的故事。

scripts.text:
[Nydhogg the Guardian]
It's what I always have with me.
I'm sure it will protect you someday.
scripts.translation:
[守護者 尼德霍格]
這是我一直隨身攜帶的東西。
我相信總有一天它會保護你。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
(Removes his scarf from around his neck and hands it to you.)
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
（從脖子上取下圍巾遞給你。）

scripts.text:
[Nydhogg the Guardian]
May the blessing of Mother Yggdrasil be with you...
scripts.translation:
[守護者 尼德霍格]
願母親 尤克特拉希爾的祝福與你同在...

scripts.text:
[Loki]
I'll be staying here for a while.
We may meet again.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
我會在這裡停留一段時間。
我們也許還會再見面。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
The day when Morocc reveals his despicable nature...
I will be waiting for him.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
當摩洛克暴露其卑鄙本性的那一天...
我會在那裡等著他。

scripts.text:
It's a giant flower with mysterious energy.
It's reacting to the Mysterious Flower Seeds you have with you.
scripts.translation:
這是一朵散發著神秘能量的巨大花朵。
它正在對你隨身攜帶的神奇的花種子產生反應。

scripts.text:
It's a giant flower with mysterious energy.
It looks like it has some special use, but you're not sure what.
scripts.translation:
這是一朵散發著神秘能量的巨大花朵。
它看起來似乎有特殊用途，但你不確定是什麼。

scripts.text: Observe the reaction.
scripts.translation: 觀察反應

scripts.text: Stop the reaction.
scripts.translation: 阻止反應

scripts.text:
The flower started to shake violently
and swing forward as if trying to send the seeds as far away as possible!!!
scripts.translation:
花朵開始劇烈搖晃，
並向前擺動，似乎想盡可能把種子甩遠！！！

scripts.text:
As you hold onto the Mysterious Flower Seeds tightly,
the flower shook violently and then became calm again.
scripts.translation:
當你緊緊握住神奇的花種子時，
花朵劇烈搖晃了一會兒，然後恢復了平靜。

scripts.text: It looks like it has some special use, but you're not sure what.
scripts.translation: 它看起來似乎有特殊用途，但你不確定是什麼。
